verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only export, including a Roam JSON export format. Export does not show that Logseq can import notes. There is no evidence of import from Notion, Evernote, Roam, or Markdown, and nothing about preserving structure, links, or attachments. Community posts mention users coming from Roam, Bear, or Obsidian but do not describe any import capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my existing notes from Notion, Evernote, Roam, or plain Markdown with structure, links, and attachments preserved
